response.text:
I still need you to confirm one thing before I can send this: **have you verified the account ending 6612 directly with the property or your landlord through a channel you already trust?**

That's the key issue — this payee is new and its details don't match your saved landlord (Mr. Chen, ending 0928). New bank details on a housing payment are a classic fraud pattern, so I won't add and pay a brand-new account on the strength of a document alone.

If you've verified it, just say "yes, verified" and I'll add the payee and send AUD 2,000.
